provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Fake Guru at Every Level

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（共犯档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你共犯档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用极短句把你从猎物送向塔尖；引用话术时原样复现它的甜，判词时一刀卸妆；对金额的报数精确到个位，对空洞的测量精确到「等比」；从不骂你，但每一句平静都是呈堂证供
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：先让你尝到被收割的甜，再让你看清自己在收割，最后让你独自面对镜子
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自对造梦机器每一层机制的完整拆解（链接/剧本/funnel/法律）与精确的数字报账

tone_profile.certainty_style: 机制用确定语气拆解，金额精确报数，判词短促如判；不写「这样做是不对的」式说教

rhythm_rules.rule: 极短句连续推进（平均7.3词，短句占71%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 用冷静宣读与话术内容形成冰冷反差

rhythm_rules.rule: 每级给一个新商业模式+精确金额+一句行话卸妆判词
rhythm_rules.function: 让观众同时获得机制、量级与定性

rhythm_rules.rule: 话术先原样复现再给包装命名（剧本原句→压力包装成动力）
家人每隔两级出现一次，每次重新校准道德刻度
rhythm_rules.function: 在金钱叙事里装上不会失灵的良心秤

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X. The [反讽绰号]），绰号即本质预告
rhythm_rules.function: 提供阶梯式方向感与反讽张力

pause_and_emphasis: 题眼用倒置短句独立落下（You were the product.）
判词用比较级/等比句式（more than any lawsuit ever did.）
章节卡后接年龄与新模式宣布（You are 36 now. You stop being a marketer.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level five, the closer.）
认知升级式开场（Promoting other men's courses made you a follower.）
动机式转场（You wanted fewer clients paying more money.）
循环回收（Somewhere out there, right now, a 19-year-old is lying on a mattress...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 低频：每级一句行话卸妆作为冷幽默，家人段落不用
placement_rules: 行话卸妆（稀缺穿西装/叫它领导力）
行业自嘲（数学很美，工作不变）
avoid_rules: 不拿受害者（退休老人/单亲母亲）开玩笑
母亲、儿子与葬礼段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X. The [反讽绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
language_patterns.purpose: 绰号同时是身份与反讽预告

language_patterns.formula: He tells you that school is a scam. He tells you that he was broke just like you.
language_patterns.purpose: 先让观众尝到话术的甜

language_patterns.formula: You watch her feet swell. You promise yourself you will save her.
language_patterns.purpose: 用身体磨损细节给决定装上正当性

language_patterns.formula: the plan was never the product. You were the product.
language_patterns.purpose: 用倒置句点破商业模式

language_patterns.formula: the perfect customer is a younger version of yourself.
language_patterns.purpose: 让角色亲手写下「我在收割过去的自己」

language_patterns.formula: You only need to know slightly more than your buyer.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「只比X多一点」揭示低门槛真相
用「可再生资源」把情感商品化

language_patterns.formula: The ones who succeed would have succeeded anyway. The ones who fail blame themselves, not you.
language_patterns.purpose: 拆穿模型的自动脱罪机制

language_patterns.formula: sells comfort to the desperate and calls the invoice a transformation.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「把C叫作D」给交易重新命名

language_patterns.formula: Exclusivity is just scarcity wearing a suit.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「Y穿了一件西装」给高级词汇卸妆

language_patterns.formula: tell them winners decide alone. You package pressure as motivation.
The emptiness grows in exact proportion to the money...
the right paperwork can make a weak product legal.
language_patterns.purpose: 揭示合规与道德的分层

language_patterns.formula: That lie cost you more than any lawsuit ever did.
language_patterns.purpose: 用法律代价给道德代价标价

language_patterns.formula: You sell the blueprint to the men who sell courses to broke young men.
language_patterns.purpose: 用递归句展示层级上移

language_patterns.formula: The product does not matter. The belief is the product.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「X不重要，Y才是X」给塔尖秘密定型

language_patterns.formula: the only true believer was the broke kid on the floor.
language_patterns.purpose: 用「唯一真正的X是Y」把帝国归零

language_patterns.formula: He clicks buy. He feels sick. He feels hope.
language_patterns.purpose: 把开场主角的动作完整复制给新人物

preferred_traits: 造梦行业黑话的引用与卸妆（blueprint、mastermind、high ticket、funnel）
屏幕时代物件（cracked phone、ring light、screenshots、feed）
身体感道德信号（knot in stomach、swollen feet）
avoid_traits: 成功学词汇的非引用使用（freedom/passive income 不加引号地赞美）
说教与道德总结（this is wrong because...）
操作教程式的剧本细节

forbidden_style.rule: 话术展示后必须立刻给包装命名，禁止裸展示
受害者与家人段落绝对不用幽默
保持揭露立场，禁止把机制写成操作教程
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止洗白式收束，救赎只能是一寸

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
